campaign: Phase 6: Genuine Meteorological Data Acquisition, Independent Flood Evidence, Authentic Sentinel-1 Processing, Physical Hydrological Modelling & Research Platform Integration
study_area: Bengaluru Urban provisional study domain (1,170 cells in EPSG:6933, bounded by 77.45 - 77.75 E, 12.85 - 13.15 N)

nwp_acquisition_log.description: Log of NOAA GFS byte-range acquisition attempts and HTTP status

nwp_forecast_provenance.description: ecCodes decoded message provenance and WMO GRIB2 headers

nwp_forecast_archive.description: Cell-mapped authentic NOAA GFS forecast rainfall time series across study domain

rain_gauge_station_registry.description: Station metadata, elevation, sensor type, topographic classification, and hydrological role

ground_rainfall_observations.description: Daily 24h accumulated rainfall records from authentic ground gauges

gauge_coverage_by_cell.description: Distance to nearest gauge, density of gauges, and coverage tier for all 1,170 cells

gfs_vs_gauge_validation_metrics.description: Paired 24h NWP forecast vs ground gauge observations and error metrics

independent_flood_incident_inventory.description: Multi-source verified positive inundation sites and monitored negative sites with estimated water depths

flood_validation_ground_truth_matrix.description: Cell-by-cell ground truth classification across 1,170 provisional study cells, explicitly marking unobserved cells

flood_evidence_gate_audit.description: Scientific justification and gate status for Supervised Machine Learning Flood Prediction

sar_scene_audit_registry.description: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem verified scene audit records for pre-event, co-event, and post-event passes

sar_flood_signature_features.description: Cell-level radiometric backscatter, flood change fractions, and double-bounce detection across 1,170 cells

sar_ground_truth_cross_validation.description: Cross-validation of SAR flood signatures against Stage 6C ground truth evidence

topographic_routing_static_features.description: Slope gradients, TWI, sink depths, upstream contributing area, and runoff coefficients for all 1,170 cells

dynamic_hydrological_inundation_potentia.description: Daily 24h effective runoff depth, HIPI score, and physical flood risk tier coupled with genuine NOAA GFS forecasts
